verdict.rationale: Paddle's hosted MCP server lets agents "build and evolve your pricing model" and take actions in the account. Its codemode `execute` tool chains multiple Paddle API calls in one invocation, and agent skills cover catalog setup, so an agent can plausibly create a product and price in a single session. Nothing documents a payment-link primitive, though: checkout runs through Paddle.js overlay or inline, and the API only documents creating transactions, with no shareable link output. missing for 10: explicit API or MCP documentation of product and price create endpoints, a documented payment-link (or transaction checkout URL) capability, hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent provisioning session.
